definitions: A Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Gege Akutami.
An anime adaptation of the manga series, produced by MAPPA.
A fictional world within the manga and anime where curses and sorcerers exist.
examples: Many fans consider Jujutsu Kaisen to be one of the best new shonen series.
The animation in Jujutsu Kaisen is highly praised.
I started reading Jujutsu Kaisen last week.
